detail.title: Autonomous Generation of Significant Research Questions: Progress and Limitations
detail.summary: This proposal updates the status of the autonomous research formulation project and provides a revised notebook documenting the current gaps in algorithmic question generation frameworks, supported by source evidence on benchmarking and LLM deployment risks.

detail.title: Operational Frameworks for Autonomous Research
detail.summary: Autonomous formulation requires identifying meaningful scientific gaps rather than simple task selection. Current benchmarks focus on decision scenarios (PharmAgents) rather than open-ended question discovery.
detail.reason: Revising the notebook to satisfy requirements for substantive support from two distinct sources, replacing previous provisional findings.
